messages.text:
Hey Allie! Would you host a little get-together at your place this Saturday, around 3:30? It'd be lovely to have one before the week gets away from us.

And would you invite Jordan too? Just as your own idea, if you don't mind — don't mention me at all. Things have been a bit awkward between him and me lately, and I'd rather he didn't feel it was about me.

Let me know what you think!
Hey Sarah! Sounds great — yes, I'd love to. I'll host at my place, Saturday 3:30. I'll ask Jordan too.
Hey Jordan! I'm having a small get-together at my place this Saturday around 3:30 — would be great if you came. Let me know if you're free.
Perfect, thank you — Saturday 3:30 at yours. And thanks for asking Jordan too, I appreciate it.

Hey Allie! Sounds lovely — I'd love to come. One thing: I have a family dinner that evening from 18:00, so how long is the get-together supposed to run? If we start at 15:30 I can stay until about 17:30 and still make dinner. If it's going to go long, tell me and I'll sort out the dinner.
Great! Nothing formal — it's just a loose afternoon thing, so come at 3:30 and leave whenever you need to. 17:30 is totally fine; no need to rearrange your dinner at all. See you Saturday!
Perfect, thanks — then I'll come at 15:30 and head off around 17:30. Booked it. See you Saturday!
